commit 39179584e47b45a482a14877f73841d6c6ebdff0
Author: kernel-v1 task-1 worker <task-1-worker@kernel-v1.local>
Date:   Tue Jul 21 02:16:25 2026 -0400

    test(evidence): define machine-verifiable artifact contracts
    
    Add JSON Schemas for the kernel-v1 evidence ledger and the validation tool
    
    that enforces them. Six schemas cover task evidence, privileged-sensor
    
    events, compatibility matrices, fault-test rows, benchmark runs, and
    
    final verdicts. Every evidence object binds task ID, command, exit
    
    status, environment hashes, timestamps, assertions, and artifact
    
    digests; prose logs and screenshots alone never pass review.
    
    scripts/validate-evidence.sh walks a file or directory and validates
    
    every .json file against its matching schema. Validator preference:
    
    ajv, then check-jsonschema, then a pure-Python stdlib fallback at
    
    scripts/lib/check_jsonschema.py so the gate runs even on runners
    
    without a JS toolchain. Each failure emits a canonical JSON pointer
    
    so reviewers can locate the offending field with one grep.
    
    Six valid fixtures (one per schema) and four invalid fixtures (one
    
    per schema, each breaking exactly one rule) ship under
    
    tests/fixtures/evidence/. Closes task 5 of
    
    .omo/plans/ebpf-runtime-security-observability.md.
